  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "confidence": 0.6,
  "anomalies": [
    {
      "category": "extra_component",
      "components": ["R11"],
      "pins": ["R11.1", "R11.2"],
      "nets": ["VCC", "GND"],
      "observed": "R11 (10k) is connected directly across the main VCC rail and GND. Its pin 1 is on VCC and its pin 2 is on GND. It appears in no section of the specification, and the component table and power section do not mention it.",
      "expected": "The specification documents every functional passive on the board. A 10k resistor bridging the supply rail to ground is not a documented decoupling, pull-up or bias element, so it is not part of the intended design. It would continuously load VCC (about 0.33 mA at 3.3 V) and is an unexplained change to the power network.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"R11\") (value \"10k\")"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R11\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"R11\") (pin \"2\") (pintype \"passive\"))"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "R11 VCC 0 10k"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)"}
      ],
      "impact": "An unintended 10k load across the supply rail adds quiescent current drain on VCC and places a resistive path between the rails that the design does not intend.",
      "confidence": 0.55
    },
    {
      "category": "missing_component",
      "components": ["C3"],
      "pins": ["C3.1", "C3.2"],
      "nets": ["VCC", "GND"],
      "observed": "No component C3 exists in the netlist. The decoupling capacitors present on VCC–GND are C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C8, C9, C10 and C17.",
      "expected": "The specification lists C3 as a 100 nF local bypass capacitor on VCC–GND, alongside C2, C4, C5, C6 and C8.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(comp (ref \"C4\")"},
        {"source": "spice", "quote": "C2 VCC 0 100n"}
      ],
      "impact": "One local high-frequency bypass capacitor is absent from the supply, which slightly weakens decoupling near the MCU and other ICs. The effect is probably minor, since several other 100 nF capacitors remain.",
      "confidence": 0.3
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The design has an unexplained 10k resistor R11 directly across VCC and GND that the specification never mentions, and the specified 100 nF bypass capacitor C3 is absent from the netlist. The R11 finding is the more significant of the two."
}
